prompt: Write an ASP.NET Core middleware class RequestTimingMiddleware that measures end-to-end request duration using Stopwatch, adds an X-Response-Time-Ms response header with the elapsed milliseconds, and logs the method, path, status code, and duration at Information level using ILogger<RequestTimingMiddleware>. Register it via an extension method UseRequestTiming on IApplicationBuilder.
notes: ASP.NET Core middleware with extension method registration. Tests RequestDelegate injection and the OnStarting/header-mutation pattern.
